items.title: Purportedly AI-Generated Bomb Threat Calls Prompted School Closures and an Evacuation in Jackson and Hall Counties, Georgia
items.summary: Bomb threat calls that officials described as AI-generated prompted searches of six schools and cancellation of classes across Jackson County, Georgia. A similar call caused the evacuation of Cherokee Bluff High School in neighboring Hall County. Authorities reportedly considered the threats linked. No explosives were found, and the perpetrators and AI system were not publicly identified.
